Name: Ginger Island Vanilla Color
Author: TsorninSungold
Description:
When you use a recolor mod, it's necessary for Ginger Island's color to change as well, because the map uses the outdoor tilesheet as well as the ginger island one. The mod changes the tilesheets that the Ginger Island map pulls from so that it can be recolored separately, or maintain it's vanilla color while using a recolor for the rest of the valley.

[b]If you are using a recolor mod, but you want to keep the vanilla color for Ginger Island, make sure that you load this mod AFTER the recolor mod you are using. [/b]

This is my first mod, so I might not have done this as efficiently as other modders could.

I love using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url] mod, but as a personal preference I like the desert, beaches, and island to be the original bright colors of the vanilla game. If you also have that preference, it's pretty easy to go into DaisyNiko's mod and remove edits so that the vanilla colors aren't overwritten for those areas. However, there's no way to do that for the island. See the attached photos. Because of the way the island pulls swatches, if you remove the edits to the island that a recolor did, you will have a patchwork island. Since this mod changes where the island gets its swatches, it can be edited separately.

Note: This mod is not a recolor. It is simply the vanilla color for the island. To recolor this yourself, edit the color of the tilesheets in the folder.
